scope: Explicit paged discovery and selected capture of conversation binary attachments and same-resource file-field references from owned Nuclia citations.
implemented: Existing original-document jobs now list cited conversation metadata and download only an explicitly selected opaque attachment choice. No new transport, scheduler or authorization service is introduced.
Canonical server-built paths bind owner, completed source run, citation index, resource, field and unchanged connector configuration. Caller URLs, message IDs and attachment indexes are rejected.

Choices retain bounded filenames and canonical identifiers only. Provider URLs, tokens and conversation text are discarded; permission/configuration/cancellation fences run again before publication or cached receipt reuse.
Conversation pages and batches of at most 100 choices have explicit navigation. Unsupported non-file or split references are counted rather than silently downloaded.
Selected files become immutable private artifact revisions. Existing source-original receipts survive restart and prevent repeated downloads after a completed capture.
Browser controls use safe text rendering and existing run polling without automatic POST replay. Phone, tablet and desktop widths have no horizontal overflow.

actual_http.scope: Existing Postman simulation and real framework transport/jobs; includes denied, redirect, partial, oversized and malformed metadata cases.

browser.scope: Full local Studio and framework jobs against synthetic Nuclia HTTP responses. Actual paged browsing and selected saves exercised. This is not physical-device or personal-VM acceptance.

simulation_log.scope: Combined synthetic HTTP acceptance and browser requests, including diagnostic attempt counters and intentional failure scenarios; no live provider account.

source_evidence.discovery: Orbit returned unrelated provider operations; none were substituted. Existing local simulation was extended from primary vendor evidence.

migration: Additive private version-1 source-attachment-selections records and optional original-document operation/page/offset/attachment_id arguments. Existing two-selector file downloads and receipt keys remain compatible. Existing state/backup services retain the collection; no credential migration is required.
static: Changed Python lint and formatting, JavaScript syntax and diff whitespace checks pass.
validation_pending: Descriptor settings outside the supported binding profile and frozen document/evaluation equivalence, including independent REMi scoring semantics.
Non-file and split attachment references; vendor ephemeral-link equivalence and remote historical original revisions. Saved captures explicitly report remote_revision_pinned=false.
Live Nuclia credentials, account permissions, generation quality and billing; physical devices and personal HTTPS VM deployment.
Remaining frozen milestone and cross-cutting acceptance gates. This slice does not promote the Nuclia catalog entry or entire plan.
concurrent_changes: index.html and quick-build.js changes are outside this slice. studio.css hash captures the current shared checkout, including independent pre-existing Quick Build rules.
